result.summary: This session completed the three deliverables (proof-search-map.yaml, source-novelty-audit.yaml, this receipt) remaining after a prior interrupted attempt at TASK-20260830-bcff45 had already produced mechanism-card.yaml. mechanism-card.yaml's disposition (scoped_no_candidate) and its five candidates were read in full and reproduced without contradiction: C1 (Valiant's VP/VNP completeness framework) is G1-absent, classifying only other named polynomial families. C2 (Berkowitz's NC^2 determinant algorithm applied to the g_I/r_R Sylvester matrix) IS ROUTE-01-component-resultants restated as an explicit circuit-complexity result (G3, G8 absent). C3 (a genuinely new, non-withdrawn 2025 constant-depth polynomial-size algebraic circuit for polynomial GCD, arXiv:2506.23220, instantiated to z_R = gcd(g_I, r_R)) requires the full Theta(B^3) coefficient vector of r_R as a circuit input and computes gcd(g_I, r_R) rather than the remainder r_R mod g_I this round's primary trigger shape targets (G3, G8 absent). C4 (the Valiant-Skyum-Berkowitz-Rackoff depth-reduction theorem and its independently retrieved modern limits) presupposes an unestablished sub-Theta(B^3)-size circuit and changes depth, not size (G3, G8 absent). C5 (the sumcheck/GKR doubly-efficient interactive-proof/argument-system lineage) is EXPLICITLY marked G1-absent per the dispatch's mandated distinction: it verifies a value supplied by an external, already-informed prover rather than constructing one, corroborated by the internal Libra record (KN-LIT-4716, prover time O(C)). Every candidate considered (C1-C5) is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8); none passes every item. The proof-search-map.yaml applies the four mandated cheap audits (exact baseline reproduction, observation-collision search, quantifier-order statement, method-ceiling nearby-object control) plus the lossy-projection test, all confirming the same structural verdicts by an independent route; the source-novelty-audit.yaml labels every source recalled, retrieved, kb, or internal, confirms no overlap with B66, B67, B70, the six screened pre-admission packets, the two P1553 mixed-radix packets' own reviews, or the seventh- through twelfth-round trigger searches (with the one re-encountered withdrawn paper, arXiv:2511.05035, disclosed rather than re-screened), and assigns novelty_status known, adaptation, or unverified per candidate with no claim exceeding retrieved or opened evidence.
